section: RICE > TRANSPLANTED PUDDLED LOWLAND RICE > 1.5. HARVESTING
quote: Taking the average duration of the crop as an indication, drain the water from the field 7 to 10 days before the expected harvest date as draining hastens maturity and improves harvesting conditions.

section: RICE > TRANSPLANTED PUDDLED LOWLAND RICE > 1.5. HARVESTING
quote: When 80% of the panicles turn straw colour, the crop is ready for harvest. Even at this stage, the leaves of some of the varieties may remain green.

section: RICE > TRANSPLANTED PUDDLED LOWLAND RICE > 1.5. HARVESTING
timing: dehusk grains from most mature tiller
quote: Confirm maturity by selecting the most mature tiller and dehusk a few grains. If the rice is clear and firm, it is in hard dough stage.

section: RICE > TRANSPLANTED PUDDLED LOWLAND RICE > 1.5. HARVESTING
timing: when most grains at base of panicle in hard dough stage
quote: When most of the grains at the base of the panicle in the selected tiller are in a hard dough stage, the crop is ready for harvest. At this stage harvest the crop, thresh and winnow the grains.

section: RICE > TRANSPLANTED PUDDLED LOWLAND RICE > 1.5. HARVESTING
quote: Dry the grains to 12% moisture level for storage. Grain yield in rice is estimated only at 14% moisture for any comparison.

section: RICE > TRANSPLANTED PUDDLED LOWLAND RICE > 1.5. HARVESTING
quote: Maturity may be hastened by 3-4 days by spraying 20% NaCl a week before harvest to escape monsoon rains.

condition: poor storable varieties (ADT 38, ADT 46) at 10% moisture

input: seeds in gunny or cloth bags
quote: Store the seeds in gunny or cloth bags for short term storage (8-9 months) with a seed moisture content of 12 - 13 %.
Store the seeds in polylined gunny bag for medium term storage (12- 15 months) with a seed moisture content of 8 - 9 %.
Store the seeds in 700 gauge polythene bag for long term storage (more than 15 months) with a seed moisture content less than 8 %.
